## Checklist (the maintainer checks every item; please check yours)
- [ ] I opened or commented on an issue first (not needed for a typo)
- [ ] Small, about one thing
- [ ] Tests added or changed; `python -m pytest -q -W error` passes
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] No key, token, e-mail, local path or private data anywhere, including the history
- [ ] Safety is not weakened (F12 stop, controls-card allow-list, spending caps, pinned hosts), or I explain why
- [ ] No new network host or dependency, or I explain why and the licence
- [ ] No training example comes from an AI model's output; the origin of each example is recorded
- [ ] Any number I added in the README or a results file comes from a file the code wrote
- [ ] I used AI assistance: yes / no. If yes, I read and tested every line myself

*This repository does not merge outside changes before 9 Nov 2026 (event rules). See CONTRIBUTING.md.*
